handoff.summary: Direction changed at 21:30 JST (PRD rewritten; §28 updated). The game is now: draw a creature, it races ITSELF in its own lane on a clean white architectural sheet seen tilt-shift. No tapping, no hazards, no dark, no Rapier. Rooms only share drawings + one seed; every client simulates the same race and the host's results are authoritative. Fairness across creature kinds is required. A working simulation start (self-running races, 9 kinds, deterministic, headless tests) is on branch m0-prototype; main still has the old Best in Show code.
next: Seat A: bring src/body.ts, analyze.ts, race.ts, creature.ts, bots.ts, dmath.ts, test/ over from branch m0-prototype; fix wing detection and the snake sliding backwards; add the fairness balance test
Seat B: the Sheet renderer (white architectural page, lanes, tilt-shift), draw screen with live preview, lobby/draw/race/results screens
Seat C: relay + src/net.ts with start{seed, drawings} and host results; deploy to Pages
Everyone: re-read PRD §2, §5, §7, §8 and §28 before prompting; prd/brief.md is a full brief for a fresh agent
open: Team members already building the old §28 (Best in Show, tapping) need to switch; main has trmi commits for the old index.html and src/main.ts
Deploy target needs a Cloudflare account and `wrangler login` (fallback: Node ws relay on a free host)
Deadline conflict: Devpost 5:00 AM JST vs trmi 6:00 AM JST; submit by 5:00 regardless
Motion quality is judged by watching it; the user found earlier gaits unconvincing
Rapier is still in package.json but no longer used by the new direction
